Travel2-service shows 0 to 12 Service Unavailable errors identical to travel-service, consistent with same downstream route-service failure.

Station latency spiked 9ms to 24ms mean with 0.62s max transiently coincident with route incident, downstream of basic/ticketinfo chain affected by same travel/route degradation.
